record.body:
## Evidence

AGENTS.md and README.md still tell an agent to install skills and the dashboard from this repo. The code at f677417 has those directories removed. The reviewer marked this judgment.

## Consequence

Phase merge stays blocked while this finding needs a human.

## Follow-up

Edit the docs, or clear the finding if this repo should keep the old install story until a later phase.
